name: plugin-app-dependency-compatibility
goal: Generated Harness apps can generate both built-in browser testing plugins without dependency-version conflicts, while incompatible dependencies remain rejected.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The merged CLI scenario and a fresh generated app reject plugin generate playwright because the app pins @playwright/test 1.63.0 but the default plugin requests ^1.28.1; the exact-string admission rejects the mismatch before generating files.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The app template and plugin catalog cases check each template independently but never compare their Playwright dependency declarations. Strengthen the existing generated-app case to check both built-in plugin versions without changing its registered case count.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red proof 00585cfbce41eeacba8c9e8b2bf7b9a640c2ac9ff826cac68e59581369a47275 at 7995e8020b fails the existing app case: both plugin declarations differ from the generated app dependency.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 99f8b7c3b4 uses one pinned Playwright version for generated apps and both built-in testing plugins; strict incompatible dependency rejection remains unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green proof e3a2da5eb8471d8c2f99bbb42bd0ba3ef994757c0cf31335ab88d6c227ed7295 at 99f8b7c3b4 passes the unchanged test and fixture from red proof a267ca4677b33307ce9c402aa02d86602e467af5b53bf294fb5c560bd6245070 at 950f317aa0 in the same environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
